fr.elements: Main Residence; Vehicle Parking Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Access Drive; Open Green Space; Detached Structure
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Limited Turnaround Space
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the road in both directions.
• Identify and mark a secondary access point so responders arriving for the first time can locate it quickly.
• Clear and maintain a designated turnaround area large enough for emergency vehicles, and keep it free of parked vehicles and equipment.
• Keep the access drive free of parked vehicles on both sides to allow full-width passage for emergency vehicles.
• Mark or sign the entrance to the detached structure so responders can locate it without delay.
• Keep the area around the detached structure accessible and clear of stored items that would block vehicle or foot approach.
• Post the full property address at the main road entrance, not only at the residence, to guide responders directly to the correct driveway.
